data.hook: Rookie Kahlil Benson steps into the spotlight, set to protect Patrick Mahomes on his NFL debut against Denver's fierce pass rush.
data.name: Chiefs Rule Out Simmons and Conner for Broncos Opener
data.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs will miss left tackle Josh Simmons, sidelined by a back injury, and safety Chamarri Conner for Monday's season opener against the Denver Broncos at Arrowhead Stadium. Undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson, who impressed in training camp, makes his debut at left tackle, with Jaylon Moore starting at right tackle. Coach Andy Reid expressed optimism about the depth options, while defensive star Chris Jones is good to go despite a minor calf issue. The Broncos arrive fully healthy, setting up a tough test for Mahomes in his return from last season's ACL injury.

data.hook: Oklahoma's narrow loss to Michigan and Texas's last-second win over Ohio State on September 12 have traditional SEC fans venting online with memes and pleas to ship the newcomers back.
data.name: Fans Call for Texas and Oklahoma's Return to Big 12 After Early SEC Struggles
data.summary: Texas and Oklahoma joined the SEC ahead of the 2024 season for tougher competition and bigger payouts, but after Oklahoma fell 17-10 to Michigan and Texas scraped by Ohio State 24-23, frustrated supporters are flooding posts with calls to send them back to the Big 12. Fans point to past Big 12 blowouts and share memes like a dump truck plunging off a cliff or Norman Rockwell's 'Freedom of Speech' painting to argue the schools don't measure up. Some see it as typical rival banter mixed with real disappointment over inconsistent results.

data.hook: Eli Gillman broke free for a 75-yard touchdown sprint in the fourth quarter, sealing a blowout win and etching his name into the record books forever.
data.name: Eli Gillman Ties Big Sky Rushing TD Record in Grizzlies Rout
data.summary: Montana Grizzlies running back Eli Gillman rushed for 147 yards and three touchdowns on 17 carries, powering No. 3 Montana to a 35-14 victory over Utah Tech for a 3-0 start. His performance tied the Big Sky Conference record with 56 career rushing touchdowns and made him Montana's all-time leader with 60 total touchdowns, while pushing his career rushing yards past 4,000. The Grizzlies' balanced offense racked up 462 yards, with Brooks Davis catching 12 passes for 151 yards, as the defense held Utah Tech scoreless until the fourth quarter. Teammates and fans celebrated the milestone from the Dassel, Minnesota native in his historic senior season.

data.hook: Coach Lane Kiffin turned heads striding down Victory Hill with rap stars Lil Wayne and Boosie, as LSU fans cheered the Louisiana flavor ahead of kickoff.
data.name: Kiffin Walks Tiger Stadium with Lil Wayne and Boosie Before LSU's 45-14 Win
data.summary: Joined by New Orleans natives Lil Wayne, Boosie, and former LSU star Tyrann Mathieu, Kiffin hyped the crowd during the traditional Tiger Walk, with LSU dubbing it 'LilWeezyana State University.' On the field, No. 8 LSU overcame a sloppy first half—marked by QB Sam Leavitt's three picks and a 100-yard pick-six—to dominate Louisiana Tech 45-14 in the second half. The blend of celebrity energy and a gritty home victory boosted Baton Rouge's game-day vibe, improving LSU to 2-0 before facing Ole Miss.

Some chalked it up to the turf's washed-out look under stadium lights, but the odd visuals sparked widespread chatter among fans watching the 7:30 p.m. ET kickoff.

data.hook: Texas trailed by 20 in the fourth quarter, but Arch Manning delivered key passes to flip the game against top-ranked Ohio State. Fans and analysts split fast on the young quarterback's big moment.
data.name: Arch Manning's Comeback Win Fuels Quarterback Debate
data.summary: No. 4 Texas stunned No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 on September 12 in Austin, with junior quarterback Arch Manning going 23-of-37 for 196 yards, a touchdown, and an interception while sparking three scoring drives. Supporters like Robert Griffin III and Dez Bryant praised his clutch plays and 2025 stats over 3,000 yards on a tough schedule, while critics including Mark Gunnels and Plies called out completion rates around 62 percent, decision-making issues, and questions about his talent beyond the family name. The divide captures the pressure on Manning at Texas, where clutch comebacks excite fans but struggles against elite defenses draw doubt.

data.hook: Ohio State blew a 20-point lead in the fourth quarter, letting Texas quarterback Arch Manning lead a 24-23 comeback win in Austin. Now Barstool's Tate must honor his preseason guarantee with a Big Mac-fueled punishment.
data.name: Ohio State's Tate Faces 24-Hour McDonald's Stint After Texas Upset Loss
data.summary: Tate promised he'd spend 24 hours straight in a McDonald's if Ohio State didn't go undefeated, eating a Big Mac to shave off each hour. After No. 1 Ohio State's shocking 24-23 defeat to No. 4 Texas on Saturday, fans dubbed the challenge 'The Arch Man(ing)' in honor of Manning's three touchdown drives. Reactions blend sympathy with jokes about McShits and endless Cokes, as Tate gears up for the endurance test while Texas celebrates and Buckeye fans await the memes.
